items.html:
Amrit Bhattarai is a left-arm medium-pacer who took part in Nepal's campaign in the Under-19 World Cup in 2006, taking four wickets in the tournament. He is part of their squad for the U-19 World Cup in 2008 as well. Bhattarai's favourite cricketer is Sachin Tendulkar.
Cricinfo staff February 2008
